_comment: A pack that belongs to no company, for the fast tests.
Every value here is deliberately unlike any real template's: the palette
is invented, the type scale starts at 24pt rather than 16, and the
smallest role is 10pt rather than 9.  The tests that use it assert
behaviour -- that roles resolve, that series cycles, that min_readable
follows the scale -- and would pass against any pack.
The suite used to assert one company's cyan, so six tests failed on a
fresh clone of the skill, which ships no packs at all.
There is no template.pptx beside this file on purpose: pack_for() resolves
a pack from a path, and the path does not have to exist for the profile
beside it to be found.  A binary fixture would cost 2MB and prove nothing.
name: fixture
